Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a cooperative agreement relating to the timber harvest excise taxation of timber harvests within the Quinault Indian Reservation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to cooperative agreements concerning the timberharvest excise taxation of timber harvests on fee land within theboundaries of the Quinault Indian Reservation; adding new sections tochapter 43.06 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 84.33 RCW; andcreating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that in certain areasof taxation, where both a tribe and the state have jurisdiction andwhere there are challenges to administering a tax, tax compacts betweenthe state and a tribe are a sound approach to resolving issues andsimplifying processes. The legislature specifically recognizes that inthe area of the timber excise tax, within the Quinault IndianReservation, the state faces challenges due to access to land andaccess to taxpayers. The activity being taxed takes place entirelywithin the reservation and is regulated by the tribe and by the state.The legislature therefore finds that shifting from a state administeredtax, to a tribal tax credited against the state tax, will bringbenefits such as consistent taxation, improved forest practices andwater quality, improved fisheries, and sustainability. The legislature p. 1 SB 5903intends to further the government-to-government relationship betweenthe state of Washington and the Quinault Indian Reservation byauthorizing the governor to enter into contracts related to timberharvest excise taxes.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.06 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The governor may enter into timber harvest excise tax contractsconcerning the harvest of timber. All timber harvest excise taxcontracts must meet the requirements for timber harvest excise taxcontracts under this section. The terms of a timber harvest excise taxcontract are not effective unless authorized in a bill enacted by thelegislature. (2) Timber harvest excise tax contracts shall be in regard totimber harvests on fee land within the boundaries of the QuinaultIndian Reservation and are not in regard to timber harvests on trustland or land owned by the tribe within the boundaries of the QuinaultIndian Reservation. (3) A timber harvest excise tax contract with the Quinault IndianReservation must provide for a tax credit against all state and localtimber harvest excise taxes, as follows: (a) A taxpayer, who is subject to timber harvest excise taxes underchapter 84.33 RCW, is eligible for an exemption from one hundredpercent of the state and local timber harvest excise tax in the form ofa credit; and (b) The taxpayer must submit information that may be required bythe department of revenue or Quinault Indian Reservation, in the formand manner agreed to by contract and prescribed by the department ofrevenue and the Quinault Indian Reservation. (4) Timber harvest excise tax contracts must be for renewableperiods of no more than eight years. (5) Timber harvest excise tax contracts must include provisions forcompliances, such as inspection procedures, recordkeeping, and auditrequirements. (6) Tax revenue retained by the Quinault Indian Reservation must beused for essential government services. Use of tax revenue forsubsidization of timber harvesters is prohibited. SB 5903 p. 2 (7) The timber harvest excise tax contract may include provisionsto resolve disputes using a nonjudicial process, such as mediation. (8) The governor may delegate the power to negotiate the timberharvest excise tax contracts to the department of revenue. (9) Information received by the state or open to state review underthe terms of a contract is subject to the provisions of RCW 82.32.330. (10) The timber harvest excise tax contract must include disputeresolution procedures, contract termination procedures, and provisionsdelineating the respective roles and responsibilities of the tribe andthe department of revenue. (11) For the purposes of this section and sections 3 through 8 ofthis act: (a) "Essential government services" means services such as forestland management, protection, enhancement, regulation and stewardship offorested land, land consolidation, tribal administration, publicfacilities, fire, police, public health, education, job services,sewer, water, environmental and land use, transportation, utilityservices, and economic development; (b) "Forest land" is defined as provided in RCW 84.33.035(4); (c) "Harvester" is defined as provided in RCW 84.33.035(6); (d) "Indian tribe" or "tribe" means the Quinault Indian Reservationlocated within the state of Washington; and (e) "Timber" is defined as provided in RCW 84.33.035(17).

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.06 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The governor is authorized to enter into timber harvest excisetax contracts with the Quinault Indian Reservation. Contracts adoptedunder this section must provide that the tribal timber harvest excisetax rate be one hundred percent of the state timber harvest excise tax.A credit is allowed against the state timber harvest excise tax, asprovided in section 2(3) of this act. (2) A timber harvest excise tax contract under this section issubject to section 2 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 84.33 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The taxes imposed by this chapter do not apply to any timber p. 3 SB 5903harvests on fee land within the boundaries of the Quinault IndianReservation during the effective period of a timber harvest excise taxcontract subject to section 2 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.06 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Quinault tribal ordinances for timber harvest excise taxation, orother authorizing tribal laws, which implement the timber harvestexcise tax contract subject to section 2 of this act, must incorporateor contain provisions identical to chapter 84.33 RCW that relate to thetax rates and measures (such as stumpage values).

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.06 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The timber harvest excise tax contract subject to section 2 of thisact must contain provisions stating the responsibilities of thedepartment of revenue and the Quinault Indian Reservation in regards tothe administration, collection, and enforcement of timber harvestexcise taxes imposed under the contract.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.06 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The timber harvest excise tax contract subject to section 2 of thisact must contain provisions requiring that the tax structure,implementation, tax rates, measures, relevant exemptions, and creditsare to be jointly audited by the Quinault Indian Reservation and thedepartment of revenue.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.06 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The Quinault Indian Reservation and the department of revenue mustwork jointly towards ensuring that the administration, enforcement, andcollection of the timber harvest excise tax, imposed under the contractsubject to section 2 of this act, is conducted in accordance withcustomary business standards.
